title: Feed UI Upgrade — Elevated Cards, Composer Pill, Labeled Actions

items.title: Collapsed composer pill
steps: Load / with a fresh session
Observe the composer before focusing the textarea
items.expected: Composer reads as one cohesive card: avatar + muted pill-shaped prompt field + Post button on the same row; no harsh inner borders; expanded state still reveals Photo row and taller textarea.
items.evidence: Rev 3: Post integrated inside feed-composer-track; user screenshot review + localhost:5180 2026-08-01.

items.title: Expanded composer behavior preserved
steps: Focus the composer textarea
Attach a photo and submit a post
Blur with empty content and confirm collapse
items.expected: Photo picker, character warn, Enter-to-submit, busy/error states unchanged; post appears in feed after submit; composer collapses when empty on blur.
items.evidence: Single textarea preserves focus on expand; build green.

items.title: Full-bleed post images on feed
items.precondition: Signed in; at least one feed post with an image attachment
steps: Scroll the feed to a post with a photo
Compare image width to card padding and avatar column
items.expected: Non-activity post images break out to card edges (edge-to-edge within the card); rounded corners and subtle ring/shadow remain; profile-activity posts keep their existing avatar/cover treatments.

items.title: Labeled action row on desktop
steps: On a feed post, inspect Comment and Share controls
Add or view reactions
Resize to ~375px width
items.expected: At md+ breakpoints, action buttons show icon + short label (Comment, Share); reaction cluster unchanged functionally; at narrow widths labels hide and icons-only layout remains tappable.
items.evidence: PostActionRow showLabels with hidden md:inline labels.

items.title: Feed list rhythm and card elevation
steps: Scroll through several posts
Hover a post card (pointer device)
Toggle dark mode
items.expected: Consistent vertical rhythm between composer and posts; cards use refined shadow/hover elevation from feed tokens; stagger enter animation still runs; readable in light and dark.
items.evidence: User dark-mode screenshot review localhost:5180; space-y-6 feed rhythm.

items.title: Empty and signed-out states
items.precondition: Account with zero feed posts; separate signed-out visit
steps: View feed with no posts — observe empty state
Log out and visit / — observe welcome card
items.expected: Empty state and signed-out welcome card share upgraded illustration/icon treatment, typography, and CTA styling consistent with feed-card language; Find friends / Sign in still work.

items.title: Caught-up footer
items.precondition: Signed in; scroll until no more pages
steps: Infinite-scroll to the end of the feed
Observe the footer message
items.expected: End-of-feed reads as a deliberate divider + muted message (not bare text); loading-more indicator unchanged while fetching.

items.title: Post detail page parity
items.precondition: Signed in; open any post via feed click-through
steps: Navigate to /posts/{id} from the feed
Inspect post image layout and action row at desktop and mobile widths
items.expected: Post detail uses same full-bleed media and labeled Comment/Share at md+ as the feed; comments section below unchanged structurally.

items.title: Profile timeline unchanged
steps: Open your profile timeline
items.expected: Profile timeline embedded post cards keep prior inset media and icon-only actions (not restyled by this plan).
items.evidence: ProfilePage PostCard uses embedded variant without new props; defaults inset + icon-only.
